ns2:course.label: Energy and Global Environment
ns2:course.description: Introduction to evaluating multiple impacts of engineering decisions. Topics include mass and chemical balances; effects of engineered systems on local and global environment, health, and risk; economic, consumer, and social considerations; provision of conventional and renewable energy; and future projections. Design projects emphasize making appropriate decisions by quantifying total impact and evaluating social environment. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: PHYS 211; PHSY 213; CEE 201 or IE 310; CEE 202, IE 300, or STAT 200; or permission of instructor. CEE students only.
